answer: Each agent identity must be anchored to a hardware enclave: a tamper-proof haven whose private key cannot be cloned or exported. Enrollment crosses one serialized wharf, at most one identity per chip per epoch, admitted in order, so a thousand puppets wait a thousand epochs. Rewards are flat per identity, not proportional to stake, so splitting a hoard earns no more than one honest node. Each sybil thus needs a real chip and real cash but earns only a comet's glint, while the capital cost stays permanent. Mass registration becomes a losing trade.
